svg.title: HyperWeave — stacked lockup, dark
svg.desc: HyperWeave stacked lockup, dark: three rows on a centre axis over a void floor, ambient lift and blooms seated on the mark row and the type rows.

hw:chromatic.theory: emissive value ladder — area-weighted, single hue family

hw:motion.vocabulary: ambient-lift, body-caustic-drift, spark-scatter, brand-bloom-breathe, organic-breathe, vertex-dilate

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: Give dark its own field program. The previous two dark builds were the light emission recoloured, and that is structurally impossible to make work: on light the ground is simultaneously the brightest element and the largest, so the value ladder is monotonic by construction. Recolouring that puts a large mid-value field second on the ladder, above everything except the lockup, and the field then wins by mass even while losing on peak.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Three axes were re-derived rather than re-tinted. CHROMATIC: the ladder is rebuilt area-weighted, not peak-weighted — void #01030A across roughly seventy percent of the canvas, a wide ambient at #0A2758 lifting only the lockup neighbourhood, a dim body caustic at #0A5CD8, brand-bound blooms at #2E7CFF, and a sparse #CFEFFF spark pass, giving an area-weighted field mean around L 0.028 against a lockup peak of 0.954, a thirty-five-fold separation that matches the light emission's thirty. Every rung is one hue family and each is strictly darker than the next. MOVEMENT: on light a 0.30 wash hides a 55px pan; on dark the same pan sweeps a hot shape across void, so amplitude falls as contrast rises — pans drop to 26 and 28 px on periods stretched to 52 and 63 seconds, displacement halves from 5-15 to 3-9, and both point lights are reined into the lockup's neighbourhood instead of parading the full width. The four breathing periods are set apart (18, 15, 21, 26 seconds) so nothing beats in sync. SPACE: the inversion is undone. The light emission lifts the ground behind the mark; the previous dark build mirrored that by darkening behind the mark, which produced a hole flanked by two blobs and left ionized chrome with nothing to reflect. Here the light concentrates ON the brand — an ambient radial peaked on the lockup, a bloom seated on the mark and a dimmer one under the type — while the vignettes widen to 170 and 96 so the frame reaches true void with a falloff long enough to hide its own edge. The gem is unified across both schemes as one idea: a translucent body over a lit pool. Only the pool changes hue, near-white on light and azure bloom on dark, which is why the facet ramp can keep darkening downward in both.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: The dark emission is now a different program, not a palette of the light one — separate filters, separate field structure, separate motion constants. No token-swap or hex-substitution build can generate one from the other, and the two must be maintained as siblings. That also means the adaptive file can no longer embed a shared field: it is deliberately held at v3.9.2 rather than rebuilt against an ungated program, since whatever dark ships is what it has to carry. The spark pass at specular exponent 150 is expensive — a second full-canvas filtered layer with its own turbulence — and pushes the dark file past the light one on paint cost; it is the element doing the most work and the first thing to cut if a surface stalls. Concentrating light on the brand makes the composition dependent on the lockup's position, so any future reflow of the lockup must move the ambient centre and both bloom seats with it, which the light emission never required. Widening the vignettes to 96 top and bottom means the mark's vertical tips sit over pure void; they read because the lockup draws above the vignette, but the field gives them no support. The ionized ramp keeps the re-saturated #2E7CFF waist, whose largest adjacent jump is 2.39x — inside the band the original waist fix targeted, but it is not the v3.7.1 ramp and the two should not be mixed across emissions. Reduced motion remains unresolved: CSS animation:none does not stop SMIL.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: Row solve identical to the approved light stacked emission: mark translate(400,178) scale 1.50 spanning x280-520 y58-298; wordmark translate(22.92,-276.4) scale 1.24, width 658.1 centred, cap block 356-420.5; subtitle centred x400 y470.5 at 14px/0.17em. Ambient radial centred (400,300) r520. Blooms at (400,178) r230 on the mark row and (400,430) r240 under the type rows, so each row of the stack sits in its own lit neighbourhood. Vignette 110 on all four sides, widened from 88.

svg.text: The artifact layer for agent-human representations
